pieces.title: What an award says about your IT provider

blocks.text:
Most business owners don't choose an IT provider because of an award.
They choose one they can trust. So what does an award actually tell you?

Simplicity Software received the MSP Award 2025 for Best use of AI Technology.

For a growing business, that matters for one simple reason. AI is moving fast, and it's hard to tell what's useful from what's noise. Outside recognition is one signal that a provider is putting AI to work well, not just talking about it.

The same idea is behind how we describe ourselves. We're not just another managed service provider. A managed service provider looks after your technology. As a Managed Intelligence Provider, we see the job a little wider: looking after your technology and helping you use it, AI included, to make the business simpler to run.

In practice, that can mean your day-to-day IT, custom web, mobile or AI software, and Microsoft licensing, all with one partner.

The award is a milestone, not the finish line. The goal is still Simplicity First: fewer things on your plate, so you can focus on your business while we handle your technology.

pieces.title: How much of your week goes to IT?
pieces.onImage: A question for business owners · How much of your week goes to IT? · simplicitysoftwarellc.com

blocks.text:
Nobody starts a business to reset passwords.
Yet for a lot of owners, it quietly becomes part of the job.

The printer stops working before a client meeting. A new hire needs an email account. An update changes something, and nobody knows why.

None of it is hard on its own. Together, it pulls you away from the work only you can do.

It rarely shows up on a calendar. It happens in small pieces: between calls, at the end of the day, on a Saturday morning. And time spent on technology is time not spent on customers, your team or where the business goes next.

That's the work we take off an owner's plate. Managed Services for day-to-day IT. 24/7 support for the things that can't wait. One partner, so there's less to keep track of. We've done this for more than 15 years, with 500+ clients.

So, a question for the owners reading this: what's one tech task you'd hand off first, if you could?

Focus on your business while we handle your technology.

pieces.title: Signs your business has outgrown spreadsheets

blocks.text:
Spreadsheets are where a lot of good businesses start.
They aren't always built for where the business goes next.

A few signs it may be time for something built around how you work:

– The same information lives in more than one place, and nobody is sure which version is current.
– Only one person really understands how the file works.
– Your team copies data by hand between tools that don't talk to each other.
– People work around off-the-shelf software, instead of it working for them.
– Customers or staff need something on their phones, and a spreadsheet isn't made for that.
– Simple questions about your own business are hard to answer.
– You've heard a lot about AI, but you're not sure where it fits in your business.

None of this means the spreadsheet failed. It usually means the business grew.

Through our Custom Software service, we build web, mobile and AI tools around the way you already work. The goal is Simplicity First: fewer workarounds, not more technology.

If a few of these sound familiar, it may be worth a conversation.
